summary: Star Bulk Carriers filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release disclosing the offering price of new common registered voting shares, par value $0.01, to be issued in an equity offering in Greece. The registrant acts as issuer of the new shares, incorporated by reference into its Form F-3 and S-8 registration statements. No price per share, deal size, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or closing date is stated in the excerpt. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch for pricing terms and use of proceeds in the full exhibit.
